paper_claim_boundary: Broad prompt stress-test for SPPA. It is useful for showing approximate universal semantic intake, but it is not the preferred flight profile because broader vocabularies can increase latency and false-positive opportunities. SPPA must normalize weak labels into reviewed family proxies or unknown conservative fallback geometry.
deployment_note: Use this profile for paper stress tests and offline sweeps. For drone runtime, prefer the shorter edge prompt profile or a domain-specific prompt set validated on target hardware.
